description: Hiragana tracing practice on Rokid glasses (Japanese version of the trace shell): all 46 basic hiragana with brush-shaped per-stroke models built from KanjiVG stroke order/centerlines (CC BY-SA 3.0) and stroke widths measured from the Klee One textbook-style font (OFL). Frozen TR01 annotation system: low-brightness glyph body, stroke-order arcs with arrows at each stroke start, numbered badges outside. Write on real paper with a brush or pen, then a photo check for three coarse items only (missing/extra strokes, balance, most obvious differences) with the learner override, and cross-session progress.
name: Trace Kana
